name: rive-animator-skill
description: Code-first Rive toolkit for AI coding agents and developers: nine living recipes, a motion baker (flow, track, wave as exact keyframes), SVG and Lottie to RML, a linter for silent traps, a binary inspector, and runtime wiring for React, Vue, Svelte, Web Canvas, Flutter, SwiftUI, Android and React Native.

scripts.build:examples: python3 examples/living-mascot/build.py && for d in examples/*; do [ -d "$d" ] && rive "$d" --once; done
